verdicts.reason: The company selector showing “Grand Canyon Resort” is immediately followed on the same line by the visible annotation “admin only – operators land on their own company,” with no intervening candidate element.

The callout’s red arrow descends leftward and its arrowhead visibly lands on the upper edge of the green Content revenue metric card.

The Net payout item is itself a metric card, not an annotation callout, and no visible arrow or callout runs from that orange card to the Redemption-code fees card; the only visible link is the payout formula’s textual inclusion of code fees.

The callout’s only visible arrowhead lands on the purple Content add-ons card to the left; it does not terminate on the separate dark Merch add-ons card.

The callout says “This section” and its red arrow visibly runs up-left to the Revenue Breakdown chart’s legend/plot area, while the text describes plotted sales series, toggles, totals, and hover breakouts belonging to that chart.

The “codes used: AC” callout has a red downward arrow whose arrowhead visibly lands on the CODES USED table header/column.

The visible “Net payout: AF” item is a red annotation callout, not the line chart, and its arrow terminates specifically at the NET PAYOUT column; the proposed target combines NET PAYOUT with the separate OWED FOR CODES column and the whole summary table.

The “owed for codes: AD” arrow lands specifically on the OWED FOR CODES column, whereas the proposed target spans that column, the separate NET PAYOUT column, and the financial summary table as a whole.
The “Net payout: AF” arrow visibly terminates at the NET PAYOUT column alone, not at the combined OWED FOR CODES plus NET PAYOUT region or the entire financial summary table proposed as the target.
